description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Notification on Legal Rate and the Market Rate of Interest, w.e.f. 01.01.2018
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka establishing the Legal Rate of Interest under Section 192 of the Civil Procedure Code. It involves a regulatory matter concerning legal interest rates, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it pertains to statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
